##### (b) Explanation ^6-1-11-1-0

#### The Section on Roots ^6-1-12-0

#### Wholesome States: (1) The Root Method ^6-1-13-0

(a) Whatever states are wholesome – are they all wholesome roots? Only three are wholesome roots. The remaining wholesome states are not wholesome roots.
(b) And whatever are wholesome roots – are they all wholesome states? Yes. ^6-1-50

(a) Whatever states are wholesome – are they all of one root with a wholesome root? Yes.
(b) And whatever are of one root with a wholesome root – are they all wholesome states?
Material form produced by wholesome states is of one root with a wholesome root, but is not wholesome. Wholesome states are both of one root with a wholesome root and wholesome. ^6-1-51

(a) Whatever states are of one root with a wholesome root – are they all mutually rooted with a wholesome root?
Those wholesome roots that arise together are both of one root and mutually rooted. The remaining states born together with a wholesome root are of one root with a wholesome root, but are not mutually rooted.
(b) And whatever are mutually rooted with a wholesome root – are they all wholesome states? Yes. ^6-1-52

Those mental roots that arise together are both of one root and mutually rooted. The remaining states born together with a mental root are of one root with a mental root, but are not mutually rooted.
(b) And whatever are mutually rooted with a mental root – are they all mental states? Yes. ^6-1-88

##### (2) The Root-of-Roots Method ^6-1-16-1-0

(a) Whatever states are mental – are they all mental roots-of-roots?
Only nine are mental roots-of-roots. The remaining mental states are not mental roots-of-roots.
(b) And whatever are mental roots-of-roots – are they all mental states? Yes. ^6-1-89

(a) Whatever states are mental – are they all of one root-of-roots with a mental root?
Mental states without a root cause are not of one root-of-roots with a mental root. Mental states with a root cause are of one root-of-roots with a mental root.
(b) And whatever are of one root-of-roots with a mental root – are they all mental states?
Material form produced by mental states is of one root-of-roots with a mental root, but is not mental. Mental states are both of one root-of-roots with a mental root and mental. ^6-1-90

(a) Whatever states are of one root-of-roots with a mental root – are they all mutually rooted-in-roots with a mental root?
Those mental roots that arise together are both of one root-of-roots and mutually rooted-in-roots. The remaining states born together with a mental root are of one root-of-roots with a mental root, but are not mutually rooted-in-roots.
(b) And whatever are mutually rooted-in-roots with a mental root – are they all mental states? Yes. ^6-1-91

##### (3) The Based-on-a-Root Method ^6-1-16-2-0

(a) Whatever states are mental – are they all based on a mental root?
Mental states without a root cause are not based on a mental root. Mental states with a root cause are based on a mental root.
(b) And whatever are based on a mental root – are they all mental states?
Material form produced by mental states is based on a mental root, but is not mental. Mental states are both based on a mental root and mental. ^6-1-92

(a) Whatever states are mental – are they all based on one root with a mental root?
Mental states without a root cause are not based on one root with a mental root. Mental states with a root cause are based on one root with a mental root.
(b) And whatever are based on one root with a mental root – are they all mental states?
Material form produced by mental states is based on one root with a mental root, but is not mental. Mental states are both based on one root with a mental root and mental. ^6-1-93

(a) Whatever states are based on one root with a mental root – are they all mutually based on a root with a mental root?
Those mental roots that arise together are both based on one root and mutually based on a root. The remaining states born together with a mental root are based on one root with a mental root, but are not mutually based on a root.
(b) And whatever are mutually based on a root with a mental root – are they all mental states? Yes. ^6-1-94

##### (4) The Based-on-a-Root-of-Roots Method ^6-1-16-3-0

(a) Whatever states are mental – are they all based on a mental root-of-roots?
Mental states without a root cause are not based on a mental root-of-roots. Mental states with a root cause are based on a mental root-of-roots.
(b) And whatever are based on a mental root-of-roots – are they all mental states?
Material form produced by mental states is based on a mental root-of-roots, but is not mental. Mental states are both based on a mental root-of-roots and mental. ^6-1-95

(a) Whatever states are mental – are they all based on one root-of-roots with a mental root?
Mental states without a root cause are not based on one root-of-roots with a mental root. Mental states with a root cause are based on one root-of-roots with a mental root.
(b) And whatever are based on one root-of-roots with a mental root – are they all mental states?
Material form produced by mental states is based on one root-of-roots with a mental root, but is not mental. Mental states are both based on one root-of-roots with a mental root and mental. ^6-1-96

(a) Whatever states are based on one root-of-roots with a mental root – are they all mutually based on a root-of-roots with a mental root?
Those mental roots that arise together are both based on one root-of-roots and mutually based on a root-of-roots. The remaining states born together with a mental root are based on one root-of-roots with a mental root, but are not mutually based on a root-of-roots.
(b) And whatever are mutually based on a root-of-roots with a mental root – are they all mental states?
Yes.

#### 2-10. The Sections on Causes and the Rest ^6-1-17-0

Whatever states are wholesome – are they all wholesome causes…?
Only three are wholesome causes; the remaining wholesome states are not wholesome causes… wholesome sources… wholesome generators… wholesome beginnings… wholesome producers… wholesome nourishments… wholesome objects… wholesome conditions… wholesome origins…. ^6-1-98

Whatever states are unwholesome… whatever states are neutral… whatever states are mental – are they all mental causes… mental sources… mental generators… mental beginnings… mental producers… mental nourishments… mental objects… mental conditions… mental origins…?
Root, cause and source, generator and beginning;
producer, nourishment, object, condition and origin.
The explanation section is complete.
The Pairs on Roots are complete.

#### The Section on Clarifying the Terms ^6-2-7-0

##### (a) Positive ^6-2-7-1-0

(a) Is material form the aggregate of material form?
Form in the sense of what is dear and pleasant is form, but not the aggregate of material form. The aggregate of material form is both material form and the aggregate of material form.
(b) Is the aggregate of material form material form? Yes.
(a) Is feeling the aggregate of feeling? Yes.
(b) Is the aggregate of feeling feeling? Yes.
(a) Is perception the aggregate of perception?
Perception in the sense of a view is perception, but not the aggregate of perception. The aggregate of perception is both perception and the aggregate of perception.
(b) Is the aggregate of perception perception? Yes.
(a) Are mental formations the aggregate of mental formations?
Apart from the aggregate of mental formations, the remaining mental formations [variant: avasesā saṅkhārā saṅkhārā (Syā.)] are mental formations, but not the aggregate of mental formations. The aggregate of mental formations is both mental formations and the aggregate of mental formations.
(b) Is the aggregate of mental formations mental formations? Yes.
(a) Is consciousness the aggregate of consciousness? Yes.
(b) Is the aggregate of consciousness consciousness? Yes. ^6-2-26

##### (b) Negative ^6-2-7-2-0

(a) Is what is not material form not the aggregate of material form? Yes.
(b) Is what is not the aggregate of material form not material form?
Form in the sense of what is dear and pleasant is not the aggregate of material form, but it is form. Apart from form and the aggregate of material form, the rest are neither form nor the aggregate of material form.
(a) Is what is not feeling not the aggregate of feeling? Yes.
(b) Is what is not the aggregate of feeling not feeling? Yes.
(a) Is what is not perception not the aggregate of perception? Yes.
(b) Is what is not the aggregate of perception not perception?
Perception in the sense of a view is not the aggregate of perception, but it is perception. Apart from perception and the aggregate of perception, the rest are neither perception nor the aggregate of perception.
(a) Is what is not mental formations not the aggregate of mental formations? Yes.
(b) Is what is not the aggregate of mental formations not mental formations?
Apart from the aggregate of mental formations, the remaining mental formations are not the aggregate of mental formations, but they are mental formations. Apart from mental formations and the aggregate of mental formations, the rest are neither mental formations nor the aggregate of mental formations.
(a) Is what is not consciousness not the aggregate of consciousness? Yes.
(b) Is what is not the aggregate of consciousness not consciousness? Yes. ^6-2-27

##### (b) Explanation ^6-3-5-3-0

#### Explanation of the Section on Terms ^6-3-6-0

#### The Section on Clarifying the Terms ^6-3-7-0

##### (a) Positive ^6-3-7-1-0

(a) Is the eye the eye base?
The divine eye and the eye of wisdom are eyes, but not the eye base. The eye base is both the eye and the eye base.
(b) Is the eye base the eye? Yes.
(a) Is the ear the ear base?
The divine ear and the stream of craving are "ear" (sota), but not the ear base. The ear base is both the ear and the ear base.
(b) Is the ear base the ear? Yes.
(a) Is the nose the nose base? Yes.
(b) Is the nose base the nose? Yes.
(a) Is the tongue the tongue base? Yes.
(b) Is the tongue base the tongue? Yes.
(a) Is the body the body base?
Apart from the body base, any other body is a body, but not the body base. The body base is both the body and the body base.
(b) Is the body base the body? Yes.
(a) Is material form the visible-form base?
Apart from the visible-form base, any other material form is material form, but not the visible-form base. The visible-form base is both material form and the visible-form base.
(b) Is the visible-form base material form? Yes.
(a) Is sound the sound base? Yes.
(b) Is the sound base sound? Yes.
(a) Is scent the scent base?
The scent of virtue, the scent of concentration and the scent of wisdom are scents, but not the scent base. The scent base is both scent and the scent base.
(b) Is the scent base scent? Yes.
(a) Is taste the taste base?
The taste of meaning, the taste of the Dhamma and the taste of liberation are tastes, but not the taste base. The taste base is both taste and the taste base.
(b) Is the taste base taste? Yes.
(a) Is touch the touch base? Yes.
(b) Is the touch base touch? Yes.
(a) Is the mind the mind base? Yes.
(b) Is the mind base the mind? Yes.
(a) Is a state the mental-object base?
Apart from the mental-object base, any other state is a state, but not the mental-object base. The mental-object base is both a state and the mental-object base.
(b) Is the mental-object base a state? Yes. ^6-3-10

##### (b) Negative ^6-3-7-2-0

(a) Is what is not the eye not the eye base? Yes.
(b) Is what is not the eye base not the eye?
The divine eye and the eye of wisdom are not the eye base, but they are eyes. Apart from the eye and the eye base, the rest [variant: avasesā (Syā., Pī.)] are neither the eye nor the eye base.
(a) Is what is not the ear not the ear base? Yes.
(b) Is what is not the ear base not the ear?
The divine ear and the stream of craving are not the ear base, but they are "ear" (sota). Apart from the ear and the ear base, the rest are neither the ear nor the ear base.
(a) Is what is not the nose not the nose base? Yes.
(b) Is what is not the nose base not the nose? Yes.
(a) Is what is not the tongue not the tongue base? Yes.
(b) Is what is not the tongue base not the tongue? Yes.
(a) Is what is not the body not the body base? Yes.
(b) Is what is not the body base not the body?
Apart from the body base, any other body is not the body base, but it is a body. Apart from the body and the body base, the rest [variant: avaseso (Syā.)] are neither the body nor the body base.
(a) Is what is not material form not the visible-form base? Yes.
(b) Is what is not the visible-form base not material form?
Apart from the visible-form base, any other material form is not the visible-form base, but it is material form. Apart from material form and the visible-form base, the rest are neither material form nor the visible-form base.
(a) Is what is not sound not the sound base? Yes.
(b) Is what is not the sound base not sound? Yes.
(a) Is what is not scent not the scent base? Yes.
(b) Is what is not the scent base not scent?
The scent of virtue, the scent of concentration and the scent of wisdom are not the scent base, but they are scents. Apart from scent and the scent base, the rest [variant: avasesā (Syā.)] are neither scent nor the scent base.
(a) Is what is not taste not the taste base? Yes.
(b) Is what is not the taste base not taste?
The taste of meaning, the taste of the Dhamma and the taste of liberation are not the taste base, but they are tastes. Apart from taste and the taste base, the rest are neither taste nor the taste base.
(a) Is what is not touch not the touch base? Yes.
(b) Is what is not the touch base not touch? Yes.
(a) Is what is not the mind not the mind base? Yes.
(b) Is what is not the mind base not the mind? Yes.
(a) Is what is not a state not the mental-object base? Yes.
(b) Is what is not the mental-object base not a state?
Apart from the mental-object base, any other state is not the mental-object base, but it is a state. Apart from a state and the mental-object base, the rest are neither a state nor the mental-object base. ^6-3-11

For those in the formless realm, the visible-form base has not arisen there, but the mental-object base will arise there. For those in the Pure Abodes and those in their final existence in the formless realm, the visible-form base has not arisen there, and the mental-object base will not arise there either.
(b) And for whomever and wherever the mental-object base will not arise, has the visible-form base not arisen for them there?
For those in their final existence in five-aggregate existence, the mental-object base will not arise there, but the visible-form base has arisen there. (b) And for whomever and wherever the mental-object base will not arise, has the mind base not arisen for them there?
For those in their final existence, the mental-object base will not arise there, but the mind base has arisen there. For those in the Pure Abodes, the mental-object base will not arise there, and the mind base has not arisen there either.

For those passing away with eyes but without ears, the eye base ceases, but the ear base does not cease. For those passing away with eyes and ears, the eye base ceases, and the ear base ceases too.
(b) And for whomever the ear base ceases, does the eye base cease for them?
For those passing away with ears but without eyes, the ear base ceases, but the eye base does not cease. For those passing away with ears and eyes, the ear base ceases, and the eye base ceases too.

For those passing away with eyes but without a nose, the eye base ceases, but the nose base does not cease. For those passing away with eyes and a nose, the eye base ceases, and the nose base ceases too.
(b) And for whomever the nose base ceases, does the eye base cease for them?
For those passing away with a nose but without eyes, the nose base ceases, but the eye base does not cease. For those passing away with a nose and eyes, the nose base ceases, and the eye base ceases too.

(b) And for whomever the visible-form base ceases, does the eye base cease for them?
For those passing away with material form but without eyes, the visible-form base ceases, but the eye base does not cease. For those passing away with eyes, the visible-form base ceases, and the eye base ceases too.

(b) And for whomever the mind base ceases, does the eye base cease for them?
For those passing away with mind but without eyes, the mind base ceases, but the eye base does not cease. For those passing away with eyes, the mind base ceases, and the eye base ceases too.

(b) And for whomever the mental-object base ceases, does the eye base cease for them?
For those passing away without eyes, the mental-object base ceases, but the eye base does not cease. For those passing away with eyes, the mental-object base ceases, and the eye base ceases too. (Based on the eye base.) ^6-3-120

### The Pairs on Elements ^6-4-0

#### The Section on Terms ^6-4-1-0

##### (a) Outline ^6-4-1-1-0

There are eighteen elements – the eye element, the ear element, the nose element, the tongue element, the body element, the visible-form element, the sound element, the scent element, the taste element, the touch element, the eye-consciousness element, the ear-consciousness element, the nose-consciousness element, the tongue-consciousness element, the body-consciousness element, the mind element, the mind-consciousness element, the mental-object element. ^6-4-1

(b) Is the ear element the ear?…

(b) Is the eye-consciousness element eye-consciousness?…

(b) Is the mind element the mind?

(b) Is the mind-consciousness element mind-consciousness?

(b) Is the mental-object element a state? ^6-4-2

#### The Section on Occurrence: 1. Arising ^6-4-10-0

#### (1) Present ^6-4-11-0

##### (a) Positive: Person ^6-4-11-1-0

(a) For whomever the eye element arises, does the ear element arise for them?
For those being reborn with eyes but without ears, the eye element arises, but the ear element does not arise. For those being reborn with eyes and ears, the eye element arises, and the ear element arises too.
(b) And for whomever the ear element arises, does the eye element arise for them?
For those being reborn with ears but without eyes, the ear element arises, but the eye element does not arise. For those being reborn with ears and eyes, the ear element arises, and the eye element arises too.
(a) For whomever the eye element arises, does the nose element arise for them?
For those being reborn with eyes but without a nose, the eye element arises, but the nose element does not arise. For those being reborn with eyes and a nose, the eye element arises, and the nose element arises too.
(b) And for whomever the nose element arises, does the eye element arise for them?
For those being reborn with a nose but without eyes, the nose element arises, but the eye element does not arise. For those being reborn with a nose and eyes, the nose element arises, and the eye element arises too.
(a) For whomever the eye element arises, does the visible-form element arise for them? Yes.
(b) And for whomever the visible-form element arises, does the eye element arise for them?
For those being reborn with material form but without eyes, the visible-form element arises, but the eye element does not arise. For those being reborn with eyes, the visible-form element arises, and the eye element arises too.
(a) For whomever the eye element arises, does the mind-consciousness element arise for them? Yes.
(b) And for whomever the mind-consciousness element arises, does the eye element arise for them?
For those being reborn with mind but without eyes, the mind-consciousness element arises, but the eye element does not arise. For those being reborn with eyes, the mind-consciousness element arises, and the eye element arises too.
(a) For whomever the eye element arises, does the mental-object element arise for them? Yes.
(b) And for whomever the mental-object element arises, does the eye element arise for them?
For those being reborn without eyes, the mental-object element arises, but the eye element does not arise. For those being reborn with eyes, the mental-object element arises, and the eye element arises too.
(The Pairs on Elements should be analysed in the same way as the Pairs on Sense Bases were analysed, and made the same.) ^6-4-18

#### The Section on Terms ^6-5-6-0

##### (b) Explanation ^6-5-6-1-0

#### The Section on Clarifying the Terms ^6-5-7-0

##### (a) Positive ^6-5-7-1-0

(a) Is suffering the truth of suffering? Yes.
(b) Is the truth of suffering suffering?
Apart from bodily suffering and mental suffering, the remaining truth of suffering [variant: avasesaṃ dukkhasaccaṃ dukkhasaccaṃ (Syā.) and likewise below] is the truth of suffering, but not suffering. Bodily suffering and mental suffering are both suffering and the truth of suffering.
(a) Is origin the truth of the origin?
Apart from the truth of the origin, any other origin is an origin, but not the truth of the origin. The truth of the origin is both origin and the truth of the origin.
(b) Is the truth of the origin origin? Yes.
(a) Is cessation the truth of cessation?
Apart from the truth of cessation, any other cessation is a cessation, but not the truth of cessation. The truth of cessation is both cessation and the truth of cessation.
(b) Is the truth of cessation cessation? Yes.
(a) Is the path the truth of the path?
Apart from the truth of the path, any other path is a path, but not the truth of the path. The truth of the path is both the path and the truth of the path.
(b) Is the truth of the path the path? Yes. ^6-5-10

##### (b) Negative ^6-5-7-2-0

(a) Is what is not suffering not the truth of suffering?
Apart from bodily suffering and mental suffering, the rest is not suffering [variant: avasesaṃ dukkhasaccaṃ na dukkhaṃ (Sī., Syā., Ka.) evaṃ avasesesu tīsu saccesu], but it is the truth of suffering. Apart from suffering and the truth of suffering, the rest are neither suffering nor the truth of suffering.
(b) Is what is not the truth of suffering not suffering? Yes.
(a) Is what is not origin not the truth of the origin? Yes.
(b) Is what is not the truth of the origin not origin?
Apart from the truth of the origin, any other origin is not the truth of the origin, but it is an origin. Apart from origin and the truth of the origin, the rest are neither origin nor the truth of the origin.
(a) Is what is not cessation not the truth of cessation? Yes.
(b) Is what is not the truth of cessation not cessation?
Apart from the truth of cessation, any other cessation is not the truth of cessation, but it is a cessation. Apart from cessation and the truth of cessation, the rest are neither cessation nor the truth of cessation.
(a) Is what is not the path not the truth of the path? Yes.
(b) Is what is not the truth of the path not the path?
Apart from the truth of the path, any other path is not the truth of the path, but it is a path. Apart from the path and the truth of the path, the rest are neither the path nor the truth of the path. ^6-5-11

### The Pairs on Formations ^6-6-0

#### The Section on Terms ^6-6-1-0

##### (a) Outline ^6-6-1-1-0

There are three formations – the bodily formation, the verbal formation, the mental formation. In- and out-breathing is the bodily formation; thought and examination are the verbal formation; perception and feeling are the mental formation. Apart from thought and examination, all states associated with consciousness are the mental formation. ^6-6-1

#### (1) Present ^6-6-9-0

##### (a) Positive: Person ^6-6-9-1-0

(a) For whomever the bodily formation arises, does the verbal formation arise for them?
At the moment of arising of in- and out-breathing without thought and examination, the bodily formation arises, but the verbal formation does not arise. For those attaining the first jhāna, for those in the sense realm, at the moment of arising of in- and out-breathing, the bodily formation arises, and the verbal formation arises too.
(b) And for whomever the verbal formation arises, does the bodily formation arise for them?
At the moment of arising of thought and examination without in- and out-breathing, the verbal formation arises, but the bodily formation does not arise. ### The Pairs on Underlying Tendencies ^6-7-0

There are seven underlying tendencies – the underlying tendency to sensual desire, to aversion, to conceit, to wrong view, to doubt, to desire for existence, to ignorance. ^6-7-1

#### The Section on the Place of Arising ^6-7-1-0

Where does the underlying tendency to sensual desire lie latent? In the sense sphere, in two kinds of feeling, the underlying tendency to sensual desire lies latent there.
Where does the underlying tendency to aversion lie latent? In painful feeling, the underlying tendency to aversion lies latent there.
Where does the underlying tendency to conceit lie latent? In the sense sphere, in two kinds of feeling, in the form sphere and in the formless sphere, the underlying tendency to conceit lies latent there.
Where does the underlying tendency to wrong view lie latent? In all phenomena included in personal existence, the underlying tendency to wrong view lies latent there.
Where does the underlying tendency to doubt lie latent? In all phenomena included in personal existence, the underlying tendency to doubt lies latent there.
Where does the underlying tendency to desire for existence lie latent? In the form sphere and in the formless sphere, the underlying tendency to desire for existence lies latent there.
Where does the underlying tendency to ignorance lie latent? In all phenomena included in personal existence, the underlying tendency to ignorance lies latent there.
The section on the place of arising. ^6-7-2

##### The Section on Arising ^6-7-11-4-0

(a) For whomever the underlying tendency to sensual desire arises, does the underlying tendency to aversion arise for them? Yes.
(b) And for whomever the underlying tendency to aversion arises, does the underlying tendency to sensual desire arise for them? Yes.
(a) For whomever the underlying tendency to sensual desire arises, does the underlying tendency to conceit arise for them? Yes.
(b) And for whomever the underlying tendency to conceit arises, does the underlying tendency to sensual desire arise for them?
For a non-returner, the underlying tendency to conceit arises, but the underlying tendency to sensual desire does not arise. For three kinds of person, the underlying tendency to conceit arises, and the underlying tendency to sensual desire arises too. (To be expanded.) ^6-7-330

(a) For whomever the underlying tendency to sensual desire does not arise, does the underlying tendency to aversion not arise for them? Yes.
(b) And for whomever the underlying tendency to aversion does not arise, does the underlying tendency to sensual desire not arise for them? Yes.
(a) For whomever the underlying tendency to sensual desire does not arise, does the underlying tendency to conceit not arise for them?
For a non-returner, the underlying tendency to sensual desire does not arise, but the underlying tendency to conceit does arise. For a worthy one, the underlying tendency to sensual desire does not arise, and the underlying tendency to conceit does not arise either.
(b) And for whomever the underlying tendency to conceit does not arise, does the underlying tendency to sensual desire not arise for them? Yes. (To be expanded.)

##### (2) Arising and Arisen ^6-8-14-2-0

(a) For whomever a given consciousness arises, is that consciousness arisen for them? Yes.
(b) And for whomever a given consciousness is arisen, does that consciousness arise for them?
Consciousness at the moment of dissolution is arisen, but does not arise. Consciousness at the moment of arising both is arisen and arises.
(a) For whomever a given consciousness does not arise, is that consciousness not arisen for them?
Consciousness at the moment of dissolution does not arise, but is arisen. Past and future consciousness neither arises nor is arisen.
(b) And for whomever a given consciousness is not arisen, does that consciousness not arise for them? Yes. ^6-8-106

##### (3) Cessation and Arisen ^6-8-14-3-0

(a) For whomever a given consciousness ceases, is that consciousness arisen for them? Yes.
(b) And for whomever a given consciousness is arisen, does that consciousness cease for them?
Consciousness at the moment of arising is arisen, but does not cease. Consciousness at the moment of dissolution both is arisen and ceases.
(a) For whomever a given consciousness does not cease, is that consciousness not arisen for them?
Consciousness at the moment of arising does not cease, but is arisen. Past and future consciousness neither ceases nor is arisen.
(b) And for whomever a given consciousness is not arisen, does that consciousness not cease for them? Yes. ^6-8-107

##### (4) Arising ^6-8-14-4-0

(a) For whomever a given consciousness does not arise, has that consciousness not arisen for them?
Past consciousness does not arise, but has arisen. Consciousness at the moment of dissolution and future consciousness neither arises nor has arisen.
(b) And for whomever a given consciousness has not arisen, does that consciousness not arise for them?
Consciousness at the moment of arising has not arisen, but does arise. Consciousness at the moment of dissolution and future consciousness neither has arisen nor arises. ^6-8-108

(a) For whomever a given consciousness arises, will that consciousness arise for them? No.
(b) And for whomever a given consciousness will arise, does that consciousness arise for them? No.

Future consciousness does not arise, but will arise. Consciousness at the moment of dissolution and past consciousness neither arises nor will arise.
(b) And for whomever a given consciousness will not arise, does that consciousness not arise for them?
Consciousness at the moment of arising will not arise, but does arise. Consciousness at the moment of dissolution and past consciousness neither will arise nor arises. ^6-8-109

(a) For whomever a given consciousness has arisen, will that consciousness arise for them? No.
(b) And for whomever a given consciousness will arise, has that consciousness arisen for them? No.

Past consciousness will not arise, but has arisen. Present consciousness neither will arise nor has arisen. ^6-8-110

##### (5) Cessation ^6-8-14-5-0

(a) For whomever a given consciousness ceases, has that consciousness ceased for them? No.

Past consciousness does not cease, but has ceased. Consciousness at the moment of arising and future consciousness neither ceases nor has ceased.

Consciousness at the moment of dissolution has not ceased, but does cease. Consciousness at the moment of arising and future consciousness neither has ceased nor ceases. ^6-8-111

(b) And for whomever a given consciousness will cease, does that consciousness cease for them? No.

Consciousness at the moment of arising and future consciousness does not cease, but will cease. Past consciousness neither ceases nor will cease.
(b) And for whomever a given consciousness will not cease, does that consciousness not cease for them?
Consciousness at the moment of dissolution will not cease, but does cease. Past consciousness neither will cease nor ceases. ^6-8-112

(b) And for whomever a given consciousness will cease, has that consciousness ceased for them? No.

Consciousness at the moment of arising and future consciousness has not ceased, but will cease. Consciousness at the moment of dissolution neither has ceased nor will cease.

For the others in four- or five-aggregate existence, neutral states will cease there, and unwholesome states have arisen there too. ^6-9-223

##### (d) Negative: Person ^6-9-31-4-0

(a) For whomever wholesome states have not arisen, will unwholesome states not cease for them? There is no such case.
(b) And for whomever unwholesome states will not cease, have wholesome states not arisen for them? They have arisen.
(a) For whomever wholesome states have not arisen, will neutral states not cease for them? There is no such case.
(b) And for whomever neutral states will not cease, have wholesome states not arisen for them? They have arisen. ^6-9-224

(a) For whomever unwholesome states have not arisen, will neutral states not cease for them? There is no such case.
(b) And for whomever neutral states will not cease, have unwholesome states not arisen for them? They have arisen. ^6-9-225

##### (e) Negative: Place ^6-9-31-5-0

Wherever wholesome states have not arisen, will unwholesome states not cease there?… ^6-9-226

##### (f) Negative: Person and Place ^6-9-31-6-0

(a) For whomever and wherever wholesome states have not arisen, will unwholesome states not cease for them there?
For those in the Pure Abodes, while the second consciousness is occurring, wholesome states have not arisen there, but unwholesome states will cease there. For beings without perception, wholesome states have not arisen there, and unwholesome states will not cease there either.
(b) And for whomever and wherever unwholesome states will not cease, have wholesome states not arisen for them there?
For those possessing the highest path, worthy ones and those who will attain the highest path immediately after a given consciousness, unwholesome states will not cease there, but wholesome states have arisen there. For beings without perception, unwholesome states will not cease there, and wholesome states have not arisen there either.
(a) For whomever and wherever wholesome states have not arisen, will neutral states not cease for them there? They will cease.
(b) And for whomever and wherever neutral states will not cease, have wholesome states not arisen for them there? They have arisen. ^6-9-227

(a) For whomever and wherever unwholesome states have not arisen, will neutral states not cease for them there? They will cease.
(b) And for whomever and wherever neutral states will not cease, have unwholesome states not arisen for them there? They have arisen.
The section on arising and cessation.
The section on occurrence is complete. ^6-9-228

#### The Section on Development ^6-9-32-0

(a) Whoever develops wholesome states – does that person abandon unwholesome states? Yes.
(b) And whoever abandons unwholesome states – does that person develop wholesome states? Yes.
(a) Whoever does not develop wholesome states – does that person not abandon unwholesome states? Yes.
(b) And whoever does not abandon unwholesome states – does that person not develop wholesome states? Yes…
The section on development.
The Pairs on States are complete.
Homage to the Blessed One, the Worthy One, the Fully Awakened Buddha
In the Abhidhamma Piṭaka ^6-9-229

### The Pairs on Faculties ^6-10-0

#### The Section on Terms ^6-10-1-0

##### (a) Outline ^6-10-1-1-0

There are twenty-two faculties – the eye faculty, the ear faculty, the nose faculty, the tongue faculty, the body faculty, the mind faculty, the feminine faculty, the masculine faculty, the life faculty, the pleasure faculty, the pain faculty, the joy faculty, the distress faculty, the equanimity faculty, the faith faculty, the energy faculty [variant: viriyindiyaṃ (Sī., Syā.)], the mindfulness faculty, the concentration faculty, the wisdom faculty, the faculty of "I shall know the unknown", the faculty of final knowledge, the faculty of one who has final knowledge. ^6-10-1

(a) For whomever and wherever the life faculty does not arise, will the joy faculty not arise for them there?
For those passing away from four- or five-aggregate existence, during life, at the moment of dissolution of consciousness, the life faculty does not arise there, but the joy faculty will arise there. At the moment of dissolution of the final consciousness, for those whose final consciousness associated with equanimity will arise immediately after a given consciousness, at the moment of dissolution of that consciousness, for those passing away from among beings without perception, the life faculty does not arise there, and the joy faculty will not arise there either.
(b) And for whomever and wherever the joy faculty will not arise, does the life faculty not arise for them there?
At the moment of arising of the final consciousness, for those whose final consciousness associated with equanimity will arise immediately after a given consciousness, at the moment of arising of that consciousness, for those being reborn among beings without perception, the joy faculty will not arise there, but the life faculty does arise there. At the moment of dissolution of the final consciousness, for those whose final consciousness associated with equanimity will arise immediately after a given consciousness, at the moment of dissolution of that consciousness, for those passing away from among beings without perception, the joy faculty will not arise there, and the life faculty does not arise there either.
